title: KAITO — At The Mercy Of The Mysterious〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: At The Mercy Of The Mysterious（4★）

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When we talked about our SEKAI selves switching places the other day, we were joking...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I never thought we'd actually see it happen.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Naturally, what happened to “us” ended up startling all of them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Especially band me. He was pretty overwhelmed by the show versions of Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Rin told me about what band her tried to do after returning...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She did the same she did that day in the hopes of returning to that SEKAI once more...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm also curious as to how that “me” is doing, so I might go take a look.
School SEKAI
Station

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's see... Ah, there he is.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough water.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
He's watering the tree.
How is it looking?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everything looks... Mhm. Normal.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's good to see. We wouldn't want major changes happening all the time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wonder why he's looking up at the tree like that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know it's just how things have to be, but it's still inconvenient that they can't hear us...
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's almost time for practice, so we came to get you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, right... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You were looking up at the tree just now. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, nothing like that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was just wondering how much taller it's going to grow.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How much taller...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's already pretty tall. Do you think it's going to get even bigger?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do you think, Ms. Ichi?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me? Umm... There's a whole range of tree species, and how tall they get depends a lot on their environment...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, actually, this tree grows based on our feelings, so I'm not sure we should compare it against any trees from our world.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Personally, I'd like to see it take in all sorts of feelings and grow as much as it can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to see it grow as tall as it can with the power of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But if it keeps growing straight upwards, it might get caught on the roof of the station...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Come to think of it, he might be right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, the fact that it's growing from the platform of a train station is already weird.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe we should have replanted it somewhere with more space when it was a little smaller...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it sprung up here all on its own, so it might be right where it needs to be.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You could try replanting it, but discover that it's returned to its original spot after a little while... That seems entirely possible.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait a second!
Shouldn't we worry more about the roof than the tree?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, why?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how it had a huge growth spurt after absorbing those black fragments of feelings?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If it can grow that fast, then next time it happens it might blast the roof wide open!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's true, their feelings are incredibly strong.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And the tree grows based on those feelings, so it might start pressing up against the roof soon.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure that this SEKAI isn't about to get in the way of these girls growing as a band...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I'm looking forward to seeing this tree's next growth spurt.

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
What's the holdup?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: It's time to start practice!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
We were here to get KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Let's go, KAITO. We're looking forward to practicing with you again today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too...
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since I'm here, I think I'll watch them practice a little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, what do we do if the tree does break the station's roof?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're still stuck on that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. If that happens, we may need to come over and help clean everything up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I hadn't thought of that!
That sounds really hard, so let's forget the whole thing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe.
